name: Bliploo Publisher
author: Bliploo

sections.description:
Bliploo Publisher connects your WordPress site to Bliploo.com.

  • Send a post/page to Bliploo manually with a button in the editor.
  • Enable automatic sync so published content is sent to Bliploo automatically.
  • Sends: title, url, image_url (featured image), and a short content summary (default max 500 characters).
  • Summary is automatic: uses the manual Excerpt when available, otherwise uses the first ~2 sentences of the content.
  • Optional Open Graph tags (og:title, og:description, og:image) so Bliploo can fetch your featured image and show preview cards.

How Bliploo shows images
Bliploo generates the preview image from your page link. This plugin can put the URL on the first line and add Open Graph tags so the preview works even without an SEO plugin.

External Services

This plugin connects to Bliploo.com to create posts in your Bliploo account.

  • Service: Bliploo Public API
  • Endpoint: https://heucbovlakegjnvzrbto.supabase.co/functions/v1/public-api/posts
  • Data sent: title, url, image_url (featured image), and a short summary (<= 500 characters).
  • When: Only when you add your own Bliploo API key and publish/update content (Auto-sync) or click “Send to Bliploo now”.

Bliploo Terms and Privacy are available on Bliploo.com.

External services

This plugin connects to an external API to publish content to Bliploo.com.

Service: Bliploo Public API
Endpoint: https://heucbovlakegjnvzrbto.supabase.co/functions/v1/public-api/posts

What data is sent:
– Post title
– Post URL
– Featured image URL (optional)
– Short content/excerpt (max 500 characters)

When data is sent:
– When an admin/editor clicks “Send to Bliploo now”, or
– Automatically on publish/update if Auto-send is enabled in plugin settings.

Terms of Service: https://bliploo.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://bliploo.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP in Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate Bliploo Publisher.
  3. Go to Settings → Bliploo Publisher and paste your Bliploo API key.
  4. Publish a post and click Send to Bliploo now (or enable Auto-sync).
sections.faq:
How do I get a Bliploo API key?

  1. Sign up / log in on bliploo.com
  2. Open Settings → API Keys
  3. Click New Key and copy the key (starts with blp_)

Why doesn’t my post show an image preview?

Make sure:
* The post has a Featured Image
* Open Graph is enabled (in this plugin or in an SEO plugin)
* The image URL is public and uses https://

Will it duplicate posts?

The plugin prevents duplicates by skipping sync when nothing changed and using a short lock to avoid double sends from WordPress hooks.

  • Enforce strict 500 character limit even when URL is added to trigger preview cards.
  • Better cleanup for HTML entities / non-breaking spaces.

0.1.1

  • WordPress.org compliance fixes.
